title: EE39006: Power Electronics Lab.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1. Familiarisation with power electronic components2. Single-phase full and
half controlled converters3. Three-phase full and half controlled converters4.
Basic non-isolated DC to DC converters5. Basic isolated DC to DC converter6.
Single and two quadrant choppers.7. Three-phase PWM voltage source inverter8.
Speed control of DC motor9. Familiarisation with three phase variable frequency
drive10. Mini project
